gates.name: Genuine referenced character motion
gates.criterion: At least one real licensed I2V inference, verified motion not merely static panning, on submitted reference image; zero character substitution

gates.name: Cross-shot character lock
gates.criterion: 12 consecutive independent shots with same approved character IDs, clothes, face geometry and accessories; two independent reviewers with documented assessment

gates.name: Complete coherent 60-second story
gates.criterion: 60-second genuinely model-generated story with causal transitions, stable cast, true body motion and end-to-end rendered AV file

gates.name: Dialogue and lip-sync
gates.criterion: Human-rated voice quality and word-to-mouth sync assessed on phoneme timing; English, Ukrainian, Russian consented voices

gates.name: Single prompt to publishable film
gates.criterion: One request creates story, reference Bible, shot renders, sound, subtitles, edit decision list, QA, owner-approved MP4 release

gates.name: Mobile native availability
gates.criterion: Real iPhone iPad Android tablet Windows macOS tests, project parity, usable UI, secure remote/local render and signed platform artifacts

gates.name: Production-grade editing and recovery
gates.criterion: Per-shot regeneration without unrelated changes, timeline editor, job cancel/resume, safe retry, artifact provenance, reproducible export

gates.name: Privacy, licenses and authorization
gates.criterion: Isolated model executor, scanned assets, model/source licenses, user consent, proof receipts, owner-signed publish permit, data retention controls

gates.name: Independent head-to-head quality
gates.criterion: Same 20 story prompts with same photo rights, equal durations and video settings; blind ratings >=3 raters each; public uncertainty and reproducible results

gates.name: Profitable premium price
gates.criterion: Paid alpha customers validate price, per-video compute cost and margins; actual checkout security and store rules independently verified before any sale
